subject: Atlas Retail trial plan & timeline
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@atlasretail.com>, Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Atlas Retail – trial follow-up and immediate next steps

Hi Olivia / Devon,

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before we scope the trial: 

Summary of needs
- Evaluate inference latency & cost for peak shopper personalization queries (~500 req/s peak).
- Validate model quality on Atlas product catalog (cold-start + SKU updates).
- Confirm integration surface: API for generation + webhook for inference logs.

Proposed trial scope & timeline (draft)
- Kickoff & environment access (1 week)
- Integration & data sync (week 1)
- Model validation & representative traffic (week 2)
- Performance tuning & cost profiling (week 3)
- Final readout with recommended config & next steps (end of week 4)

Owner roles (draft)
- Redwood: Jasmine (project lead), Marissa (SRE/SE), Rishi (commercial)
- Atlas: Olivia (product lead), Devon (engineering lead)

Can you confirm the kickoff week we discussed (week of Mar 9) and any hard constraints for the final readout date? Once I have that I’ll circulate a formal POC checklist and SOW draft.

Attachments: atlas_poc_checklist.xlsx (draft)

—
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@atlasretail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@atlasretail.com>
Date: 2026-02-21T09:11:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail – trial follow-up and immediate next steps

Thanks Jasmine — this looks good. A couple quick clarifications before we finalize dates:

1) Success criteria: for us the most important signals are (a) P95 inference latency under 120ms at 500 req/s and (b) top-5 recommendation recall >= 78% on the holiday catalog sample. Would Redwood be able to validate both?
2) Data access: we can provide a ~50k SKU export and a 14-day anonymized query log. Any specific format expectations?
3) Timeline: week of Mar 9 works for kickoff, but we need the final readout no later than Apr 6 due to internal stakeholder scheduling.

If you can confirm those items and share the SOW/checklist, we’ll start internal approval.

—
Olivia Park
Senior Product Manager, Personalization | Atlas Retail
olivia.park@atlasretail.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-22T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail – technical plan (latency & eval)

Jasmine — noted Olivia’s targets. Technical notes I’ll include in the POC doc: 

- Latency: we’ll deploy a dedicated instance with continuous batching tuned for the SKU size distribution you described. Expect baseline P95 around 90–110ms for the 500 req/s profile; the test will include a stress run with realistic key-value cache warmup.
- Quality eval: we’ll run the top-5 recall on the 50k SKU sample; need the catalog export as CSV + product embeddings if available. If you can only provide raw text, we’ll generate embeddings on our side but that adds ~1 day.
- Observability: we’ll enable token-level cost traces and a short-lived dashboard link for you to monitor.

I attached a short integration checklist and a draft of the validation scripts we plan to run.

Attachments: integration-steps.md

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@atlasretail.com>, Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-24T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Atlas Retail POC — final draft plan, success criteria & milestones

Hi Olivia / Devon — thanks for the quick reply and the clarity on dates. Per Marissa’s tech notes, we’ve finalized a POC plan that fits your Apr 6 readout requirement. Please review below and flag anything missing.

Finalized success criteria (Atlas to sign off):
- Scalability: P95 inference latency <= 120ms at 500 req/s (measured during 10-minute steady window after cache warmup)
- Quality: top-5 recommendation recall >= 78% on the provided 50k SKU sample (evaluated on the same holdout set)
- Integration: API end-to-end test passes per checklist (auth, webhook delivery, logs)

Milestone schedule (dates are proposed)
- Kickoff call & environment access: Mar 9, 2026 (Week 0) — owners: Jasmine / Olivia
- Integration & data sync complete: Mar 16, 2026 (Week 1) — owners: Devon / Marissa
- Model validation & accuracy evaluation: Mar 23, 2026 (Week 2) — owners: Marissa / Atlas analytics
- Performance tuning & cost profiling: Mar 30, 2026 (Week 3) — owners: Marissa / Rishi
- Final readout & recommendations: Apr 6, 2026 (Week 4) — owners: Jasmine / Olivia

Deliverables
- Shared Drive with artifacts: integration logs, evaluation notebook, cost dashboard link
- Short final report with recommended config and estimated monthly unit cost at production scale

Immediate asks for Atlas (please reply inline):
1) Confirm kickoff Mar 9 — who should be on the kickoff invite from your side (email + role)?
2) Provide the 50k SKU export and 14-day query log (CSV preferred). If embedding files are available, include them.
3) Any procurement/DocuSign timeline we should be aware of? Rishi will follow up on commercial paperwork.

Attachments: redwood-poc-sow-v1.pdf, atlas_poc_checklist.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-redwood-atlas-poc
HubSpot record: HS-4537

Thanks — we’ll hold internal resources for the Mar 9 start pending your confirmation.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 415-555-0192
From: Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@atlasretail.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@atlasretail.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail POC — final draft plan, success criteria & milestones

Jasmine — we’re good to kick on Mar 9. Confirmed attendees for kickoff:
- Olivia Park (product)
- Devon Shaw (eng)
- Miguel Alvarez (data infra) — miguel.alvarez@atlasretail.com

One small ask on success criteria: can we tighten the recall threshold to >= 80% for the holdout if the model is within 5% of latency target? In other words, if P95 <= 125ms, we’ll accept 80% recall; if P95 <= 120ms, baseline 78% applies. This gives our team a bit more flexibility during tuning.

Also we’ll upload the SKU export and logs to the Drive folder by EOD Mar 3. I’ll send a calendar invite for Mar 9 kickoff in a separate email.

—
Devon Shaw
Engineering Lead | Atlas Retail
devon.shaw@atlasretail.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Devon Shaw <devon.shaw@atlasretail.com>, Olivia Park <olivia.park@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Atlas Retail POC — final draft plan, success criteria & milestones

Thanks Devon — that flexibility makes sense. We can accept the conditional threshold you proposed (summary below). Confirmed: kickoff Mar 9.

Updated success criteria (final)
- If P95 <= 120ms: top-5 recall >= 78%
- If 120ms < P95 <= 125ms: top-5 recall >= 80%

Action items assigned
- Atlas: upload SKU export + logs to Drive by Mar 3 (Olivia / Miguel)
- Redwood: prep environment & baseline stress test (Marissa)
- Commercial: Rishi to start procurement paperwork and share DocuSign link (Rishi / Atlas procurement)

Procurement & paperwork — Monica is looped to help with onboarding and will coordinate DocuSign once Rishi sends the contract link. Rishi, can you share the DocuSign powerform when ready?

Thanks everyone — looking forward to kickoff.

Jasmine Liu
